draft: We're sorry to hear about the confusion and crowding at Coventry. We take your feedback seriously to improve the experience. Please DM us your booking reference so we can look into your specific journey and assist you further.

Sorry to hear about the delay and the wait at York. We know this is frustrating. If your journey was delayed by over 30 minutes, you can claim compensation via our website. For specific platform changes, please check the station displays or our app for the latest updates.

Hi there. We haven't published specific details on the website about the upgrade yet. We are aware of recent issues with the new App and are actively looking into them. Please let us know if there is anything specific you need help with.

Hi, I'm sorry for the frustration. You do need a valid ticket to pass the barriers and travel. If you've lost your physical ticket, please check your email for a digital copy or contact us directly for assistance. Please DM us your booking details so we can help.

We're sorry to hear about your recent journeys. We're aware of the disruption and are reviewing your compensation claim. Please direct message us your booking reference so we can look into this further for you.

Sorry to hear you're facing a crowded service. We aim to keep journeys comfortable, but demand can be high. Please DM us your booking details so we can look into your specific service. Thanks for your patience.

We're sorry for the delay caused by the London Midland fault. We can't confirm compensation eligibility here. Please contact Virgin Trains customer service directly with your ticket details for assistance.

We're sorry to hear your journey was overcrowded. We can't move passengers to First Class as that requires a separate fare. Please DM us your booking reference so we can look into your specific journey and see if there's anything else we can do.
Hi, sorry you've had trouble accessing your account. Please send us a DM with your details so we can look into this for you. We'll get back to you as soon as we can.
We're sorry for the disruption. We can't predict when incidents will occur, so there's no set limit. We're working to keep delays to a minimum. If you need specific help, please DM us.

We're sorry to hear about your experience. We do operate a reduced First Class service at weekends, but we understand this was disappointing. Please DM us the details of your journey so we can look into this further.

I'm sorry to hear you're stuck. Our service is running 19 minutes late, but we don't have an expected arrival time yet. Coaches have been ordered for Preston and Lancaster, though no ETA is available. Please DM us your journey details so we can assist further.

Sorry for the frustration. We can't access specific live timetable details here. For accurate platform and time info, please check the official Virgin app or station displays. If you need further help, DM us your booking reference.

We're sorry to hear about the disruption and your concerns. We take safety seriously. Please DM us your ticket details so we can look into your specific journey and assist you further. We appreciate your patience.

Sorry to hear it's too hot on board. Please speak to the crew, who can assist with ventilation or offer a cooler spot if available. We aim to keep our trains comfortable for everyone. Thanks for flagging this.
We're sorry your journey was delayed and you had a poor experience with our team. Please DM us your ticket details so we can look into a delay claim and address your feedback. We value your business.
We’re sorry for the frustration. We can’t check account details here. Please DM us your full name and booking reference so we can look into the railcard issue and next steps.
We're sorry for the inconvenience. We can't provide specific refund details here. Please contact our customer service team directly for assistance with your refund request.

I'm sorry to hear your bag was left behind and that you felt unheard. We're checking if it's still on the train. Please DM us the coach/seat and bag details so we can locate it. We'll update you as soon as we have news.

We're sorry to hear you're feeling frustrated. To help resolve this, could you please send us a direct message with your ticket details? We'll look into your options and guide you on the next steps. Thank you for your patience.

Thanks for the kind words! We're delighted you've booked. We can't promise upgrades, but we'll do our best. If you have any questions, feel free to DM us your booking reference. Have a lovely journey!

We hold certain seats for JourneyCare to avoid confusion, so they may not appear as available. We understand this is frustrating. To discuss your specific booking, please send us a DM with your reference number so we can look into it further.
Happy to guide you. Tell us your journey + date/time and the step you're stuck on, and we'll share steps.

We're sorry for the inconvenience. You can reserve seats before your journey and request a specific one. Disabled seats are often held for JourneyCare bookings. For assistance, please DM us your contact details so we can help further.

I'm sorry to hear about the missing items. We can confirm the Train Manager found them and they will be handed in to lost property at Glasgow. Please DM us your full name and contact details so we can assist you further.
Good morning! Thanks for reaching out. Could you please send us a DM with your booking reference so we can look into this for you? We'll be happy to help.

We're sorry for the confusion. We can't provide specific menu details or schedules here. Please check the Virgin Trains website for the latest timetables and dining options for your route. For account-specific help, please DM us your details.
We're sorry, but non-refundable tickets cannot be changed or refunded. If you believe this is an error, please reply with your booking reference so we can review your specific ticket details.

Sorry to hear your train was cancelled. With an advanced ticket, you can travel on the immediate service before or after your booked time. Please check the station boards for the next available departure. If you need to change your plans, let us know.

Hi. An Off Peak Open Return allows travel on any off-peak service within 28 days. However, it cannot be used on a peak train first thing tomorrow morning. You would need a separate ticket for that leg. Please DM us if you need help checking specific train times.
